text:
Amanda: Heads-up: starting blue/green shift for svc-router v3.2.1 at 23:00 UTC. Plan: 10% -> 30% -> 70% -> 100% with 5m observation between steps. Change window ends 23:30. Pinned sessions will follow new-route header. Release notes: https://redwood/release/3.2.1

theo: Copy. Can we pin by cookie for 10m to avoid sticky split? router team prefers `session=route-id`.

deploy-bot: Deploy job #5023 queued. kickoff @ 2790012345. Live CI: https://ci.redwood/jobs/5023

Sasha: Safety checks: LB drain=2m, backend warmup=3 replicas, circuit-breaker: 5% errors OR p95>350ms -> rollback. Suggest add latency gate p50>200ms -> rollback as well.

Amanda: Agree add p50>200ms gate. Also add fallback to tidy-quantized model if token-error-rate spikes.

Ben: @Amanda will pin DB schema to v4 for 30m during shift? migration is online but prefer avoid mixed reads.

Amanda: Yes - DB team prepped. We'll set `db_schema=4` flag in config. Command we'll run: ```curl -X POST https://ops/run -d 'schema=4&ttl=1800'```

deploy-bot: Shift step1: 10% -> green started. ID: shift-2790012345-step1. Monitoring: https://dash/shift/2790 and alerts: https://alerts/2790

theo: Noting a small spike in 5xx from eu-west-1 edge (~0.6% over baseline). tagging @infra-oncall for region probe.

infra-oncall: Investigating; looks like pool eu-west-1-3 had stale ENV var. Restarting pool now.

deploy-bot: Shift step1 completed. Proceeding to step2 -> 30% in 2m.

Sasha: During step2 p50 jumped to 210ms for two consecutive 1m windows and p95 trending up. That's over our p50 gate. Recommend immediate rollback.

Amanda: Rollback. Run `rbctl rollback --to=blue --reason='p50>200ms'` and drain green. Also annotate release notes and create follow-up.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated. Rollback ID rb-2790012345. Notifying on-call and opening incident: INC-9932.

Amanda: After rollback, we'll pin model variant 3.2.1 -> 3.2.0-compat and re-run perf harness against canary traffic before reattempt. Follow-up ticket: ENGOPS-418.
